title: A Hessian oscillation bound controls the Taylor residual
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: A Hessian oscillation bound controls the Taylor residual. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: If f is C² at every point of the segment from x to x+v and its Hessian differs there from D²f(x) in operator norm by at most ε, then the Taylor residual has norm at most ε‖v‖².
